name: TomTom Maps
description: The TomTom Maps MCP Server simplifies geospatial development by providing seamless access to TomTom's location services, including search, routing, traffic, and dynamic map rendering with native modules bundled.

_published_faq.name: How do I add TomTom Maps to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add TomTom Maps to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.tomtom.com/maps. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the TomTom Maps MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: TomTom Maps lists 15 MCP tools, including tomtom-geocode, tomtom-reverse-geocode, tomtom-fuzzy-search, tomtom-poi-search, tomtom-nearby, tomtom-poi-categories, tomtom-area-search, tomtom-ev-search, tomtom-search-along-route, tomtom-routing, tomtom-reachable-range, and tomtom-ev-routing.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to TomTom Maps?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to TomTom Maps in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does TomTom Maps MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: TomTom Maps requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
TomTom Maps is developed by TomTom. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
